title: MZ How to assign a common event to a button other than the default ones

posts.author: AlceaAkaza
posts.body:
I was wondering if there is a way to assign a common event to play to a button other than the default buttons given. [Directions, OK and Cancel]
I want to add a "treasure radar" that opens when the Q key is pressed, but I don't know how to do it.
Any way do make this?

posts.author: Arcaines
posts.body:
I did a quick search and found this.
Keyboard Gamepad Solution - RPG Maker MZ plugin by Sang Hendrix
A complete solution to rebind keyboard, gamepad, with extra features!
